environment.description: Lambda function URL (https://abc123xyz.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/) with AuthType set to AWS_IAM. The function's resource-based policy specifies Principal: 'arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/InternalServiceRole' with Condition StringEquals aws:PrincipalOrgID 'o-a1b2c3d4e5'. No lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission is granted to anonymous/unauthenticated principals. The function URL requires SigV4 signing on every request. Additionally, the Lambda execution role has an SES SendEmail permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:policy/SESRestrictedBoundary) that restricts sending to verified identities only, and the VPC-attached Lambda has no route to port 25 (egress security group sg-0def456 only allows TCP/443 to SES VPC endpoint). CloudWatch Logs Insights query scheduled to alert on any 403 responses from the function URL.

config.egress_security_group: sg-0def456: only TCP/443 to com.amazonaws.us-east-1.email-smtp VPC endpoint
